issues.detail: The Greek 'ουχ ευρησομεν αυτον' (we will not find him) is a statement of fact/certainty. The Vietnamese translation renders it as a question ('mà chúng ta không tìm được?'), changing the assertive tone of the Jews into an inquiry.

The Greek 'μη εις την διασποραν' (not to the diaspora) is a negative statement. The Vietnamese translation renders it as a question ('Có phải... chăng?'), which softens the definitive negation into a rhetorical or speculative question.
